title: Toolbox pickup - carry - put down - pick up
visual_acceptance: Actual LMB pickup shows full-size toolbox in the left hand and hammer in the right. E places the same toolbox nearby with the hammer on its lid; look at that resting box and LMB to pick it back up. Inspect hand/body clearance, persistence and visibility.
This review uses an undamaged practice tank. It does not prove repairs at broken components or exterior carry. Timeline timing and ordinary reach/occlusion gates still require runtime validation.
